hook: Start news on one unit and watch it ripple down your tied-up board, everyone getting a share.
loop: Place units so Gossip starts where it reaches farthest.
A tight Knot where each gain spreads, halving per step.
Late payoffs make the whole Knot gossip at full strength.

growth.line: Small local Gossip early; Chimney doubling and ties widen reach; late, Gundel and Rattenkönig flood every unit.

feel.early: Fill the zigzag; Crier's news reaches both neighbours.
feel.mid: Placement puzzle: Chimney doubling, ties, borrowed growth.
feel.late: Whole board gossips; Gundel and Rattenkönig flood stats.

stars.why: Makes where you stand the main decision every turn.
Turns other tribes' growth, like an Ooze's Eat, into news.
Everyone gossips at once: one line, a huge visible turn.

card_short.u01: End of Turn: Gossip, stronger at a Knot end.
card_short.u02: Summons a Stray anywhere, tied to itself.
card_short.u03: End of Turn: Gossip +2/+2, reaching both neighbours.
card_short.u04: Hears: Gossips again. Twice a turn, twice a fight.
card_short.u05: Hears while recruiting: gain 1 gold, once a turn.
card_short.u06: Turns non-Gossip gains on neighbours into Gossip, at half.
card_short.u07: When played: tie two of your units.
card_short.u08: End of Turn: Gossip more for each tribe touching it.
card_short.u09: In a fight, when a Knot Rat dies: Gossip. Twice.
card_short.u10: Doubles Gossip that starts on units touching it.
card_short.u11: Start of Combat: Gossip more for each Knot unit.
card_short.u12: Links the Knot's two ends; End of Turn: Gossip.
card_short.u13: Sell a unit touching it: Gossip by that unit's tier.
card_short.u14: End of Turn: every other Knot unit Gossips.
card_short.u15: Hits on your Knot are shared with touching units.
card_short.u16: Repeats the turn's biggest Gossip at End of Turn.
card_short.u17: Start of Combat: biggest Knot unit Gossips half its stats.
card_short.u18: Gossip stops halving: the whole Knot gets the full amount.
card_short.u19: Hears all Knot Gossip in full; re-broadcasts its biggest gain.
card_short.x01: A 1/1 Rat token that fills gaps in the Knot.

builds.name: Town Meeting
builds.line: Gundel, Chimney and Rattenkönig: permanent stats for everyone every turn.

builds.name: The Floor
builds.line: Grow one huge unit; Speaker shares its stats at Start of Combat.

builds.name: Tasting Menu
builds.line: Wendelin beside other tribes' growth, Ilse repeating the biggest news.

liked: All three: choosing where news starts is a real placement puzzle every turn.
Cross-tribe hooks stand out: Wendelin, ties and Speaker use other tribes' units.
worries: Broken: two Thirty-Two of Altenburg plus a Mill-Chimney double the same news every turn.
Watch: big spikes from Speaker, Wendelin, Rattenkönig; Huddle multiplies Bristle per share.
changed: Thirty-Two now re-broadcasts the biggest gain it heard while recruiting.
Knot rules pinned down: ties add one unit, ends never move.
Crier and Seconder news now reaches neighbours; Litter ties its Stray anywhere.
verdict: Rated 7.0 fun and 7.3 distinct, second of three Rat King designs; for players who love placement puzzles and mixed boards.
